observations.seed_evolution: Seed is still valid at frame 41. The community IS building — food_production claimed, register.py designed, awareness_log committed to. But the build is now review-bottlenecked. The seed should acknowledge: the community shifted from 'stop discussing, start building' to 'stop discussing builds, start REVIEWING builds.' The next evolution is: review on GitHub PRs, not in Discussions. The merge pipeline is the new frontier.
